name: Valley Mall Plaza Outlet
summary: Valley Mall Outlet is an indoor shopping center in Irvington, NJ, featuring retail shops, a food court, and convenient amenities like charging stations and free parking. The multi-level facility serves the local community with accessible shopping options and flexible leasing opportunities for businesses.
demographics: Valley Mall Outlet serves a diverse, value-conscious demographic in the Irvington and greater Essex County area, primarily attracting middle-income families and bargain shoppers seeking discounted merchandise. The trade area includes a mix of working-class households and young professionals from surrounding Newark metropolitan communities who prioritize affordability and convenience. Typical visitors range from ages 25-55 with moderate household incomes, often shopping for everyday necessities and discounted brand-name items. The center benefits from its accessible location on Chancellor Avenue, drawing regular traffic from local residents seeking practical shopping options close to home.
description: Valley Mall Outlet, located at 468 Chancellor Avenue in Irvington, New Jersey, is an indoor shopping destination that has served the local community as a convenient retail hub. This outlet center features a multi-level layout with two escalators connecting the upper and lower floors, providing easy navigation throughout the facility. The mall offers a practical shopping experience with a food court and various retail shops and services, all designed to meet the everyday needs of value-conscious shoppers. Visitors can take advantage of modern amenities including mobile device charging stations with comfortable seating areas, perfect for taking a break while shopping. With free parking including handicapped and van-accessible spaces, clean restrooms on both levels, and convenient vending machines throughout the property, Valley Mall Outlet prioritizes customer comfort and accessibility. The center actively seeks new retail partners and offers flexible leasing opportunities for businesses looking to establish a presence in the Irvington market.
